work: François Couperin — L’Art de toucher le clavecin (complete)
method: User-edited Ableton Live 12 set rendered natively, derived from published score MIDI and aligned to the human performance.
electronic: Native 320 kbps stereo MP3 exported from the user-edited Live set, then folded to mono and encoded into the single synchronized 192 kbps MP3 carrier. Each EDIT track uses the user-set minus-one-semitone MIDI Pitch effect.
lossyTranscode: Live 320 kbps MP3 decoded then re-encoded as 192 kbps MP3. A lossless Live export was attempted but could not be completed.
stereoLimitation: The existing pair encodes acoustic and electronic as separate mono channels. The Live render stereo field is folded to mono and is not preserved.
levelPolicy: Constant electronic attenuation matches acoustic integrated loudness for the existing adaptive mix; optional additional reduction protects the equal-power headroom contract. No dynamic processing.

scoreSource.changes: MIDI performance alignment; user-edited MIDI Pitch and instrument arrangement.

notesDescription: Raw score MIDI events read from the saved Live set with the Pitch effect values; instrument processing and audio are authoritative, not this event list. Excludes separately derived bass-bed events.
unvalidated: Native game playback and perceptual transition acceptance remain to be checked.
User source is a lossy MP3 and the existing carrier folds stereo to mono.
